package service

import (
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
)

// scenario for service_constructor_accepts_untyped_config_map: Services configured by `map[string]any` or similar untyped blobs.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type PaymentService struct {
	db     *sql.DB
	apiKey string
	region string
}

func NewPaymentService(cfg map[string]interface{}, db *sql.DB) (*PaymentService, error) {
	apiKey, ok := cfg["api_key"].(string)
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("missing api_key in config")
	}
	region, ok := cfg["region"].(string)
	if !ok {
		region = "us-east-1"
	}
	return &PaymentService{
		db:     db,
		apiKey: apiKey,
		region: region,
	}, nil
}
